prompt: What is the difference between a while loop and a do-while loop?
choices: While loops use a counter; do-while loops use a boolean
A while loop checks the condition before each iteration; a do-while always executes at least once
While loops require break; do-while loops use continue
explanation: while: check condition → maybe execute body → check again. do-while: execute body → check condition → maybe repeat. do-while guarantees at least one execution. Useful for menus: 'show menu, then loop while user doesn't quit'.
